resources.string: Start by adding a new reading. Enter your glucose result. You can also add an optional note with the reading and edit it later from History.
You can also add a reading for a previous date or time. Choose when the reading was taken, and add a note if you want.
In History you can review previous readings, search by date, and edit or delete any reading. You can choose a specific date to search for readings from that day.
You can edit the reading value, date, time, or note.
If a reading was added by mistake, you can delete it from History.
Here you can create a glucose-check reminder. Choose the reminder name, time, and the days when it should run.

Users / Profiles
You can create multiple users on the same phone. Each user has independent readings, reminders, history, and data analysis.

Reminders
You can manage all reminders here, add a new reminder, or edit and disable existing reminders.

Appearance
You can choose light mode, dark mode, or use the device setting automatically.

Language
You can change the app language between Arabic and English at any time.

Export data
You can export the current user\'s data to an Excel or PDF file to keep or share.

Data Analysis
You can review your data summary, including reading count, average, lowest and highest reading, and trends by period. This section summarizes recorded data and does not provide a medical diagnosis.

App tutorial
You can replay this tutorial at any time if you want to review how the app features work.

Support
GlucoTime is completely free, and you can optionally support its development through Whish Money. The support section shows the QR code and support options. No payment or QR scan is required for this tutorial.

Need an app or website?
You can contact the developer if you need an Android app, website, or custom software.
